provider._timeout_seconds: The global maximum wall for one CLI process. Each role runs under its own wall, worker_policy.stage_timeout_seconds(role) = ceil(max_turns * 45 s/turn * 1.5), and every one of those must fit under this maximum (assert_caps_fit_timeout); 2700 covers the 2025 s a 30-turn role needs. Raised from 1200, which sat exactly on a 30-turn worker's budget at the measured 40.4 s/turn (D-054).
provider._idle_timeout_seconds: A process that prints no stream-json event for this long is killed as hung, recorded, and retried once (D-054).
provider._effort_overrides: Per-role {role: level} on top of worker_policy.ROLE_EFFORT (workers medium, judges high), rendered as --effort on every request. Levels are the CLI's: low, medium, high, xhigh, max; roles are the policy's. A typo refuses the configuration. Empty means the policy as written (D-055).
provider._thinking_cap_overrides: Per-role {role: cap} on top of worker_policy.ROLE_THINKING_CAP (every row None today), exported to the CLI as MAX_THINKING_TOKENS only for a role whose cap is set: 0 disables thinking, a value of at least 1024 is the thinking budget in tokens (the CLI raises a smaller budget to 1024, so a smaller one is refused). Roles are the policy's. A typo refuses the configuration. Empty means no cap; set a row only after FACTORY_PREFLIGHT_THINKING_CAP_PROBE says the route honours it (D-059).
provider._model_overrides: Per-role {role: model_slug}: the model a role runs on instead of provider.model. A request resolves to its own model (the kernel's requests name none), else this row, else architecture_model for the architecture holdout, else provider.model. Roles are the policy's; a slug must be a non-empty string; a typo refuses the configuration. The worker workflow's route probe runs every distinct model named here (scripts/factory_models.py --list) and refuses the run if one is unreachable; the stage record and the FACTORY_STAGE line say model=<slug>. Empty means every role on provider.model. The one lever left for test_author on a route that honours neither --effort nor MAX_THINKING_TOKENS (D-061).
